# Norman Doidge, MD

> The official website of neuroscience author and psychiatrist Norman Doidge, showcasing his groundbreaking work on neuroplasticity and brain healing.

Norman Doidge is a bestselling author and researcher known for bringing neuroscience discoveries to general audiences through his acclaimed books. His work explores how the brain can rewire itself and heal through neuroplasticity.
